title: Docker CLI credentials
whyItMatters: The Docker CLI folder holds registry logins, sometimes in plain text, plus context files for remote and cloud engines. Those logins push and pull private images.
source: Docker CLI reference, configuration files: the CLI keeps its configuration in ~/.docker, with credentials in config.json: https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/
notes: config.json holds auth entries unless a credential helper is configured, in which case the helper's own store holds them. contexts/ names remote engines the user connected to. DOCKER_CONFIG can move the folder.
